tldr:
For the exact public-window causal quantile in the fixed normalized primitive-law class \(\mathcal M\), the proved frontier is
\[
R(n,h)\asymp L(n,h)\asymp s_C(n,h)
=n^{-1/2}(h\vee n^{-1/5})^{-1/2},
\]
uniformly for \(n\ge2\) and public \(0<h\le1/8\), without logarithmic factors. The elbow is \(h=n^{-1/5}\): root mean squared error, finite-90-percent-honest connected-interval length and optimal CDF-process error have order \(n^{-2/5}\) below it and \((nh)^{-1/2}\) above it. Total attaining procedures use only the \(4n\) original records and public constants, with deterministic fallbacks for rejected or singular pilots and \(2\le n<32768\). For larger samples and narrow windows, the construction works through \(H=n^{-1/5}\), pays the proved deterministic \(G_H-G_h\) allowance and still targets exact \(G_h\); for wider windows it integrates the requested window exactly before inversion. Normalized alternatives in the identical \(\mathcal M\) yield matching all-procedure floors in the full original iid experiment.
